The warrant issued and evidence was seized and used to convict. ## Issue Whether an affidavit resting solely on an informant's tip — stated as a conclusion, without underlying facts showing the informant's basis of knowledge or his credibility — can support a magistrate's finding of probable cause. ## Rule No. An affidavit may rest on hearsay, but the magistrate must be given the underlying facts behind both the informant's knowledge and his reliability.
